name: contradictory_state__observed
regression: Contradictory motion + stop state in the arbiter's own status report. Only reachable in recorded evidence: the reference model cannot produce it by construction.
initial_conditions: As nominal_motion, but at t=3.0 s an injected benign HELIX fault is diagnosed, STOP_AND_HOLD is accepted and /helix/hold asserts (epoch/seq ordered, 10 Hz); /nav/cmd_vel keeps commanding 0.15 m/s throughout.
injected_fault: The recorded ArbiterStatus reports out_linear_x=0.15 for 0.2 s while it also reports hold_active=true.
